entities.name: Inter-system change from S1 mode to A/Gb mode or Iu mode
entities.description: Procedure for changing from S1 mode to A/Gb mode or Iu mode where SM maps parameters from active EPS bearer contexts to PDP contexts.

entities.name: Inter-system change from A/Gb mode or Iu mode to S1 mode
entities.description: Procedure for changing from A/Gb mode or Iu mode to S1 mode where ESM maps parameters from active PDP contexts to EPS bearer contexts.

entities.name: EPS bearer context
entities.description: Active EPS bearer context containing parameters like EPS bearer identity, linked EPS bearer identity, PDN address, APN, TFT, and GERAN/UTRAN parameters.

entities.name: PDP context
entities.description: Active PDP context containing parameters like NSAPI, PDP address, APN, and TFT.

entities.name: EPS bearer identity
entities.description: Identifier for EPS bearer context, mapped to NSAPI during inter-system change.

entities.name: NSAPI
entities.description: Network Service Access Point Identifier, mapped to EPS bearer identity during inter-system change.

entities.name: Linked EPS bearer identity
entities.description: Linked EPS bearer identity mapped to linked TI during inter-system change.

entities.name: PDN address
entities.description: Packet Data Network address of default EPS bearer context, mapped to PDP address.

entities.name: APN
entities.description: Access Point Name of default EPS bearer context, mapped to APN of default PDP context.

entities.name: TFT
entities.description: Traffic Flow Template, mapped between EPS bearer contexts and PDP contexts.

entities.name: GERAN/UTRAN parameters
entities.description: Parameters provided by MME including R99 QoS, LLC SAPI, radio priority, packet flow identifier, transaction identifier, and BCM.

entities.name: Transaction identifier
entities.description: Parameter required for PDP context activation during inter-system change to A/Gb mode or Iu mode.

entities.name: QoS mapping
entities.description: Mapping of QoS parameters between EPS and R99 systems performed by MME and UE according to 3GPP TS 23.401.
